title: Stillwater Fishing
pitch: Walk through a sheltered forest bank into evening light, cast into a clear authored pond, hook a trout, balance the pull and release a memorable first catch.

authorization.basis: User instructed execution of PROMPT.md in a separate worktree. Launch prompt delegates bounded design, implementation, dependency installation, validation, checkpoint commits and independent four-round art review.

mustHave: Owned reproducible starter fork with preserved receipt
Authored basin, shoreline, water and excluded vegetation
Grounded walking, rod, line, float and aim/power cast
Invalid cast, missed hook and line break recovery
Start, pause, focus handling and clean restart
Real input browser validation and independent frozen-build critique
outOfScope: Other games or shared framework source
Boats, swimming, rivers, multiplayer, inventory or species catalog
Water promotion, root migration, publishing or push

milestones.title: Owned foundation
acceptance: Registered clean forest starter forked with CLI protection intact

milestones.title: Complete fishing loop
deliverables: Local pond, rules, controller and fishing presentation
acceptance: Real input lands/releases and recasts a fish
Failures, pause and restart recover cleanly

milestones.title: Verified bounded handoff
deliverables: Game docs, consumer notes, tests and review evidence
acceptance: Unit/lint/build and real browser checks complete
Independent art gate reaches 8 or four rounds with honest result

lanes.role: Integration, authored world, presentation, tests and run records
Independent read-only art and correctness review of committed source and browser captures

playthrough: Start, approach the bank using keyboard, cast through real input, wait for bite, hook, manage tension, land, release and cast again
Invalid land cast and missed-hook recovery
Over-reel to break line; pause mid-fight freezes simulation; resume and restart cleanly
Check shore boundary, focus/pointer-lock pause, quality, responsive HUD and browser errors

stopAfter: Hand over first verified playable after correctness blockers are resolved and art reaches 8/10 or four rounds. Report failed art gate at cap; no additional depth.
